skillScore.backcardInfo:
Scores are relative to other users, shown on a
scale of 1000
skillScore.skillScoreDescription:
Skill Score is a relative measure of how well you do
in tournaments with respect to all other tournament
players on CoinPoker. It's based on seven key Poker
stats and considers your all real money tournaments
played, with a possible score between 0 and 1000
skillScore.roiDescription:
Your total profits/your buy-ins,
then multiplied with log value of
your average buy-in.
skillScore.mtiDescription:
How often you finish in a prize-winning
position, then multiplied with log value
of your average buy-in.
skillScore.winningsDescriptions: The total amount you've won in tournaments.
skillScore.tournamentPlayedDescriptions:
Number of tournaments played.
Skill Score will be generated as soon
you finish your first tournament
skillScore.finalTableDescription:
Number of times you made it to the
final table, multiplied by the square
root of the number of participants
in each of those tournaments.
skillScore.rank1stDescription:
Number of times you secured a first-place
finish, multiplied by the square root of the
number of participants in each of those
tournaments.
skillScore.biggestScoreDescription: Your highest win from a single tournament.
skillScore.scoreNADescription:
Play at least 5 tournaments to get your skill
score
